vikram: Heads-up — we started seeing a spike in inter-region mTLS handshake failures right after the nightly keystore rotator ran.
vikram: Sample error from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-21T09:11:43Z proxy[ingress]: handshake failed: tls: unsupported change cipher spec message
2026-03-21T09:11:43Z proxy[ingress]: session ticket decrypt failed: could not decrypt ticket, err=KMS:Decrypt denied
```

anna: ok — two quick questions: did the rotator also rotate the session-ticket encryption key or just leaf certs?

tim: looking at KMS audit for that window — I see `kms:Decrypt` denies for the rotator principal around 09:11Z. snippet: "eventName":"Decrypt","errorCode":"AccessDeniedException","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/keystore-rotator/xyz"}"

jen: we recently tightened TLS profiles to TLS1.3-only on edge (envoy) and disabled renegotiation and tls1.2 fallbacks. some older proxies in apac still send TLS1.2 CH. could be mismatch + ticket decrypt fail.

vikram: that matches — failed handshakes are concentrated on apac->eu reads. fallback to older region succeeded for some requests. wondering whether ticket key rotation + KMS RBAC change caused decrypt denies.

anna: probable. rotator needs kms:Decrypt for the key that encrypts session tickets. we should avoid long-lived key policy edits if possible — prefer a grant for the rotator role so it's auditable and revokable.

tim: we can create a scoped, timeboxed KMS grant. example CLI (replace ARNs/IDs):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-session --grantee-principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/keystore-rotator/xyz --operations Decrypt --name rotator-temp-grant
```

jen: operationally, two mitigation paths: 1) issue temporary grant so rotator can decrypt old tickets and rekey gracefully, or 2) revert edge TLS profile to allow TLS1.2 for a short window while we complete key sync. I prefer #1.

vikram: agree. can someone own grant creation + patching rotator env? need audit trail. also add an allowlist entry in keystore logs for new grant id.

anna: I'll open the IAM change PR and request emergency review from security ops. PR will include justification, grant TTL 7d, and audit ticket reference.

tim: I'll file the KMS grant via CLI and paste grant id into the PR; will annotate with KMS CloudTrail event ids.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 - inter-region mTLS handshakes failing after keystore rotation. automated checks: cert-rotator last-run=2026-03-21T09:12Z status=FAILED (KMS Decrypt)

jen: I'll push a temporary route rule to direct apac traffic to eu-fallback pool while we validate ticket re-decrypt. smoke test plan: 5k randomized requests over 10m, measure 95p handshake success.

vikram: perfect. action items:
- anna: open RBAC PR + link INC-2026 (owner)
- tim: create grant, post grant-id + cloudtrail refs (owner)
- jen: implement temporary routing + run smoke tests (owner)
- vikram: coordinate rollback plan if grant doesn't resolve and notify infra on-call

anna: putting ETA 2h for PR, tagging @security-ops for expedited review.

tim: grant created id=1234abcd, posted in PR. KMS logs show successful Decrypt calls immediately after grant issuance.

vikram: confirming handshakes are recovering — initial success rate jumped from 62% -> 98% in apac->eu after grant applied. keep monitoring. :thumbsup:

jen: will keep smoke test running and post summary in INC-2026.

anna: make sure to include the justification in the audit trail: rotator requires Decrypt for session-ticket rekeying after scheduled cert rotation. PR references attached cloudtrail events and temporary TTL=7d.

vikram: once smoke passes, we should update the rotator runbook to include a pre-rotation KMS permission check and an automated dry-run decrypt test.

sec-bot: Reminder: please attach CI/CD evidence and grant-id to INC-2026 for compliance.

jen: noted. I'll add logs and grafana snapshots.

vikram: thanks everyone — will close thread when INC-2026 is updated and we confirm post-mortem action items are tracked.
